preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line.strip()) <= 1000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: The first line of each test case is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) representing the number of packages. Input ends when n is zero.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) >= 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit())
preconditions.description: Each package line starts with a package name followed by zero or more space-separated dependency names.

preconditions.expression: all(len(package_name) <= 40 for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() for package_name in [line.split()[0]])
preconditions.description: Each package name is a string of up to 40 non-whitespace characters using a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _, -, ., +.

preconditions.expression: all(len(dependencies) <= 20 for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() for dependencies in [line.split()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each package has at most 20 dependencies.

preconditions.expression: all(dep in all_packages for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() for dep in line.split()[1:] if dep)
preconditions.description: Each dependency is one of the other n-1 packages in the same test case. all_packages is the set of all package names in the current test case.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or all(package in stdout.splitlines() for package in all_packages)
postconditions.description: If a valid topological order exists, stdout contains all package names in the test case exactly once, in lexicographically smallest valid order. Otherwise, stdout is 'cannot be ordered'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or all(package not in [dep for dep in dependencies] for package in stdout.splitlines() for dependencies in [line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() if line.split()[0] == package])
postconditions.description: For every package in the output order, all its dependencies appear before it in the output.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'cannot be ordered' or all(stdout.splitlines().index(package) < stdout.splitlines().index(dep) for package in all_packages for dep in [line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines() if not line.strip().isdigit() if dep in line.split()[1:]])
postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, the output is the lexicographically smallest topological sort (using ASCII values for string ordering).
